; Make the ZoomButton ("x.x" zoom indicator) appear ONLY briefly while zooming
; in/out, then auto-hide — in both normal and split modes. Stock behaviour keeps
; it on screen the whole time the document is zoomed away from default, which
; overlaps the split boundary. We add a one-shot timer that shows it on every
; zoomLevel change and hides it ~1.5s after the last change.
AFFECT [[1224665461898798997]]
    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]] > [[6502786168]]#[[15549782143769420265]] > [[8398922437330412042]]#[[8400407604831274538]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL INSERT {
            property bool rmhZoomActive: false
            Timer {
                id: rmhZoomHideTimer
                interval: 1500
                onTriggered: zoomButton.rmhZoomActive = false
            }
            onZoomLevelChanged: {
                zoomButton.rmhZoomActive = true
                rmhZoomHideTimer.restart()
            }
        }
        REBUILD [[233748328658231]]
            LOCATE BEFORE ALL
            REMOVE UNTIL END
            LOCATE AFTER ALL INSERT { zoomButton.rmhZoomActive && !adjustViewPopup.visible }
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
